item.title: Abu Dhabi Launches Nutri-Mark To Simplify Healthier Food Choices
item.description: The Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council, in collaboration with the Abu Dhabi Public Health Centre, has announced support for the implementation of Nutri-Mark as part of the Healthy Living Programme, aimed at making food choices clearer and easier for the community. item.title: Guinness Joy For Bahraini Rapper
item.description: Bahraini rapper Hussam Aseem, better known as Flipperachi, has officially entered the Guinness World Records after his hit song “Fa9la” achieved an unprecedented milestone on the Billboard Arabic charts.

item.title: Bahrain: Couple Charged After Leaving Disabled Son In Hospital For 10 Years
item.description: The Head of the Family and Child Prosecution said that the Public Prosecution received a complaint from government hospitals after the parents of a patient with disabilities refused to take him home after his treatment was completed. According to the complaint, the patient, who has a mild intellectual disability, was admitted to a government hospital in 2015 due to an immune disease. item.title: Bahrain Wins Asian Handball Championship Title After Beating Qatar 29–26
item.description: The Kingdom of Bahrain national handball team won the 22nd Asian Handball Championship 2026 in the State of Kuwait, which also qualifies them for the 2027 World Cup in the Federal Republic of Germany. The team secured the title with a 29–26 win over Qatar. Bahrain led 14–11 at half-time, and the second half ended level at 24–24, forcing extra time. item.title: Saudi Arabia: All Lanes Full: Riyadh Marathon 2026 Expands Into Festival, Sells Out Ahead Of Saturday Race
item.description: Riyadh is already on the move. With the marathon festival underway and all races sold out, the capital is preparing for Saturday’s flagship race as the fifth Riyadh International Marathon reaches its peak. item.title: Saudi Arabia: Qiwa Clarifies Rules For Appointing Non-Saudis As General Managers
item.description: Saudi Arabia’s Qiwa platform clarified that non-Saudis may still be appointed to the position of “general manager,” provided specific regulatory conditions are met, following confusion over the removal of the job title from the profession-change options for expatriates. item.title: Saudi Arabia: Diriyah Contemporary Art Biennale 2026 Opens In JAX District With Global Lineup
item.description: The third edition of the Diriyah Contemporary Art Biennale opened to the public on Friday at the JAX District in Diriyah, running through May 2 and bringing together more than 65 artists from over 37 countries. Titled “In Interludes and Transitions”, the Biennale is organized by the Diriyah Biennale Foundation and led by co-artistic directors Nora Razian and Sabih Ahmed. item.title: Saudi Arabia: ZATCA Foils Smuggling Of 269,000 Captagon Pills At Al Haditha Border Crossing
item.description: Saudi Arabia’s Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) said it has thwarted an attempt to smuggle 269,411 captagon pills at Al Haditha land port, after the drugs were concealed inside a food shipment entering the Kingdom. item.title: Saudi Arabia Acknowledges ‘Effective Cooperation’ After Lebanese Authorities Seize Narco Lab
item.description: Saudi Arabia highlighted the productive cooperation between the Kingdom and Lebanon after the seizure of a drugs facility. The Saudi interior ministry said the lab was being used to manufacture narcotic substances and precursor materials, in addition to firearms.
